traditions_differ.note: Expert comparison with the earlier KB: Jupiter: the edition's chart (page 50), the sign table (page 185) and the house 11 example (page 254) all make house 11 a Jupiter pakka house. The earlier KB list omitted 11; house 11 is now included. Mercury: the text (pages 113, 185, 652) also counts house 6 as jointly held by Mercury with Ketu, though the chart shows Ketu alone; KB lists Mercury 7 only (minor). The English master chart (page 106) also gives Jupiter as the fixed-house lord of 11 and lists Mercury with Ketu in the effect columns for 6. All other entries agree: Sun 1, Moon 4, Mars 3 and 8, Venus 7, Saturn 8 and 10, Rahu 12 (Jupiter shares 12 per page 51), Ketu 6.
